subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer experiences bouts of self-importance and is easily rattled by danger.
source_quote: Calmer brags about how he can see everything.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer noticed the green slime hanging over the arch just in time.
source_quote: I noticed, just in time, the blob of green slime hanging over the arch at the bottom of the stairwell.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr removed the green slime from Calmer's armor using wood he was carrying.
source_quote: Using some wood I happened to be carrying on me, I removed the slime from his armor.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is dismissive of Calmer's distress and finds his reactions excessive.
source_quote: “Grow up,” I tell him.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia noticed the greased door hinges in the eastern storeroom.
source_quote: The door hinges are greased. For a place that should be abandoned, that’s odd.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia pulled her swords upon hearing a bang, suspecting an ambush.
source_quote: I then overhear a bang. I pull my swords, ready to strike, and realize it’s the cleric.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia wants to kill the cleric because she believes he alerted the Ogre.
source_quote: I want to kill him. If there is anything past the door to the east, it heard us.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia discovered the magical cloak of elvenkind in the Ogre’s nest.
source_quote: I look inside the Ogre’s nest and discover a magical cloak of elvenkind.

subject: The Ogre’s food source
fact: The origin of the Ogre’s food supply is a grisly mystery, but not fully explained in this session.
source_quote: An Ogre needs a lot of food. And so someone has been providing it with food.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia learned the names of the two merchant prisoners: Derrick and Florian.
source_quote: My name is Derrick, and this is Florian.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia learned the identity of the gnome spy: Jarran.
source_quote: My name is Jarran.

subject: The Duke
fact: The Duke is overconfident and believes he can control the situation from afar.
source_quote: Don’t you worry, team. I’ll make sure to guard them.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia decided to meet with the Druid first before presenting evidence to the elders.
source_quote: We should go to the Druid first.

subject: Jaroo (the Druid)
fact: Jaroo is cautious and believes evidence must be presented to the elders before action.
source_quote: You have proof of brigands. And that is important... but we must go to the elders.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia declined to accompany Calmer to speak with the Cleric.
source_quote: I tell him to go. He’s disappointed I won’t follow.

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir is suspiciously pleased when Calmer is absent and shows interest in the tower.
source_quote: Spugnoir seems particularly pleased that the cleric is not with us.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia learned from Ostler that her room had been paid for until the 19th.
source_quote: And your room has been paid for until the 19th.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia observed that Ostler was pleased she went to Jaroo before outsiders.
source_quote: And I am very pleased that you decided to go to Jaroo before going to those interloping outsiders.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia witnessed Calmer attempt to derail the Village Elder meeting by demanding the Prefect’s presence.
source_quote: “I would like to insist that the Prefect be present for these meetings.”

subject: Rufus
fact: Rufus dismissed the evidence of the Temple’s re-emergence as lacking national importance.
source_quote: We have no conclusive evidence of the re-emergence of the Temple of Elemental Evil.

subject: Burne
fact: Burne commended the party for their information and deputation.
source_quote: I want to commend our heroes for their information.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr learned from Spugnoir about the Circle of Eight and their involvement in the Battle of Emiry Meadows.
source_quote: There are tales that the circle of eight appeared.

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir reveres the Circle of Eight and believes they act only to preserve balance.
source_quote: The Circle of Eight is neither good nor evil. They only care about the balance.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia entered the tower and discovered a summoning circle and mural.
source_quote: I see permanent markings on the floor for a summoning circle and mural.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia encountered a smoke mephit who demanded entertainment to avoid attack.
source_quote: The smoke mephit turns to us and says that if we entertain him, we won’t be attacked for entering his kingdom.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr sang a song that enraged the smoke mephit.
source_quote: Zephyr tries to entertain him with some song. Unfortunately, as we learn later, that song is a song that immediately induces a blood-curdling rage in smoke and dust mephits.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr opened the second door after Zinia noticed everyone staring at it.
source_quote: Finally, Zephyr gets the point and mutters, “I will open the door.”
